page: Microsoft Azure D32ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1D cache. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is bundled, providing 1890 GB of local disk capacity with Premium Storage capability.

Benchmark data reveals strong capabilities in specific workloads alongside some performance tradeoffs. The server demonstrates strong performance in Geekbench image processing and text processing, as well as Passmark CPU physics testing. Static web serving throughput is also strong at 56.21 GB/sec. For small-scale language model tasks, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds of 355.44 tokens/sec with a 135M model, and strong prompt processing speeds of 2518.71 tokens/sec. However, memory subsystem performance represents a notable bottleneck, with the Passmark memory score falling into the weak category at 1699.64.

Given its hardware profile, the D32ds_v6 offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, and text or image processing pipelines. The inclusion of 1890 GB of local storage makes it viable for database operations, which scored an average of 13629.57 on Passmark, and Redis deployments, which achieved 46.62 million SET operations per second. While the lack of a GPU limits its utility for large-scale deep learning, the CPU's Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 support provide hardware acceleration for smaller CPU-based inference tasks.
description: The Microsoft Azure D32ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Ddsv6 family, powered by a 32-vCPU Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. It features 128.0 GB of RAM, 1890 GB of local storage, and is Premium Storage capable. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the server delivers strong performance in static web serving, Geekbench image and text processing, and small-model LLM text generation. However, it exhibits a weak Passmark memory score of 1699.64, indicating a potential bottleneck for memory-intensive operations. Supported by CPU instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX, this instance is suited for general-purpose applications, web serving, database operations, and light CPU-based machine learning inference.
